messages:
sasha: quick async check — streaming funccall events for convo/completions: current runtime emits a bunch of deltas + funccall pieces. do we have a final say on the contract for partial args across chunks? specifically: should clients expect `call_id` + chunk ordering + a final `end` flag, or rely on stream close semantics? cc @tim @anika :eyes:

tim: short answer: prefer explicit fields. propose event shape with `call_id`, `seq` (monotonic chunk index starting at 0), and `complete: true` on final chunk. that avoids relying on connection termination. example: 
```json
{
  "type": "funccall_chunk",
  "call_id": "c-abc123",
  "seq": 0,
  "complete": false,
  "payload": "{\"name\": \"search\", \"args\": \"{\\\"q\\\":\\\"puppies\\\"}\"}"
}
```

anika: compatibility note: older SDKs (<2.0) won't send/expect `seq`. fallback rule: if `seq` absent treat as single-chunk and accept `complete` true/false; also allow `payload_fragment` fields to be concatenated. we should document that clients MUST use `call_id` for idempotency.

dev-pr: heads-up I'll open a tiny PR to add this to the convo streaming contract doc and the schema linter. pinging reviewers: @tim @anika. PR will include example reassembly code.

ops-bot: schema-lint pipeline: latest image pushed to gcr.io/redwood/schema-lint:pr-1722, will validate any PRs against new rules after merge.

anika: one more Q — streaming payload encoding: do we want JSON fragments (as strings) or binary chunks (base64)? JSON fragments are easier but brittle if args contain braces across chunk boundaries.

tim: prefer base64 for opaque arg blobs to avoid parser edgecases. fields: `payload_b64` + `encoding: "b64"` when used. leave human-readable `payload` for single-chunk cases.

sasha: sounds good. can we also add `end_reason` optional field for final chunk (`end_reason: "complete" | "truncated" | "fallbacked"`) so consumers can reason about partial results?

anika: +1 for `end_reason`, helps telemetry. note: if `truncated` we should increment a metric `funccall.reassembled.truncated`.

dev-pr: PR is up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4812 — includes schema json + example reassembler in Node + unit tests. reviewers requested: @tim, @anika.

tim: will review this afternoon. rollout plan: canary 5% (1h), 25% (4h), 100% (next day) if metrics look good. ops to coordinate with eng-sre for canary windows.

sasha: ack. if nobody objects I'll merge tomorrow EOD and trigger the canary. thanks all :thumbsup:
